turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Hi, thanks for joining. I am your interviewer today. To warm up, tell me about the Android work you've done most recently.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hi I am Mintu. I am a mobile engineer. Um at E-Cash Labs, I built the Flutter wallet app. Mostly the offline payment sync. And before that, I did some Swift side projects

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: You said offline payment sync. Walk me through the toughest consistency issue you hit there and how you fixed it.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Sure. The hardest part was, like, making sure a payment was never sent twice when the network came back. I used an outbox table with an idempotency key. So the server just ignored duplicates We had zero double payments after launch

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Zero. How did you confirm that in production and what was your sample size?
